full_judgment:
Mustafa Kamal, J: This Rule under section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure is directed against a judgment of affirmance arising out of a Miscellaneous Case for pre-emption under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. The Miscellaneous Case was dismissed by the trial Court. The appellate Court below affirmed the Judgment and order of the trial Court. The two Courts below upheld the contention of the pre-emptee-opposite-parties that the application was barred by limitation. 

 For the reasons stated above, the judgment and order of the Court below need not be interfered with, although for a different reason.
